_selectors_note: page_image is null on purpose: MangaKatana's reader page never puts real image URLs in attributes -- every is a dead placeholder. Real per-page URLs are only present inside an inline

_upstream.attribution: Keiyoushi extensions-source contributors; ported to Lua for TachiKindle.

_limitations: Upstream's dynamic Genre/Status/Sort/Chapters filters and the multi-server ('Server 1/2/3') reader preference are not exposed; default server (empty ?sv= suffix) is always used.

Upstream's getSearchMangaList special-cases a query that resolves straight to a manga details page (e.g. '?search=exact-slug' short-circuiting to a single-result MangasPage); this port always treats /page/{page}?search=... as a listing page, matching the common case verified live.
details_author selector reads only the first .author anchor; upstream joins every co-author with a comma. Multi-author titles will show a truncated author list.

Upstream adds an OkHttp network interceptor that rewrites the Content-Type of octet-stream image responses so image decoders don't choke; this Lua port performs no such rewrite, so a source that mis-serves an image as application/octet-stream may fail to render where the real extension would not.
